name: context-pane
description: Live bars just above the prompt: your week and 5-hour session usage (and a monthly window when one is reported) and how full the context window is with recall zones (SHARP, GOOD, WEAKER, FORGETFUL, AUTO-COMPACT). Switch each bar on or off, split the week bar into 5 or 7 days with day names from your reset day, and have replies read aloud.

showWeek.title: Week bar
showWeek.description: The 7-day usage window as a 4 px bar with one section per day: green within pace, red ahead of it.

showSession.title: 5h Session bar
showSession.description: The 5-hour usage window, with when it resets.

showContext.title: Context bar
showContext.description: How full the context window is, with recall zones.

readAloud.title: Read aloud
readAloud.description: Read each of Claude's replies aloud (macOS, Windows and Linux). The speaker next to ⚙ switches it.

workWeek.title: Week bar: work week
workWeek.description: Split the week bar into 5 days (work week, Mon–Fri) instead of 7 (full week). The ⚙ switches show it as 5d / 7d.

showToday.title: Week bar: Today marker
showToday.description: A light grey bar, 1 px tall, just above the day section of the week bar we are in now. The ⚙ switches show it as Today.
